description: 项目原创中英例句、搭配；补充原词库缺少的中文学习语境。

carrier.en: The carrier will deliver the parcel tomorrow.
carrier.zh: 承运公司明天会送达包裹。

rape.en: The center offers support to survivors of rape.
rape.zh: 该中心为强奸受害者提供支持。

corridor.en: Her office is at the end of the corridor.
corridor.zh: 她的办公室在走廊尽头。

interior.en: The interior of the house needs painting.

pitcher.en: She poured water from a glass pitcher.

retail.en: The company sells furniture at retail.

developer.en: The developer fixed a bug in the app.
developer.zh: 开发者修复了应用中的一个错误。

dose.en: The label states the recommended dose.
dose.zh: 标签上写明了建议剂量。

plead.en: They plead for more time to finish the work.
plead.zh: 他们恳求多给些时间完成工作。

sixth.en: Our apartment is on the sixth floor.

longtime.en: She had lunch with a longtime friend.
longtime.zh: 她和一位老朋友一起吃了午饭。

render.en: This change could render the old system useless.
render.zh: 这一变化可能使旧系统失去作用。

restrict.en: The rules restrict access to this area.
restrict.zh: 这些规定限制人们进入这一区域。

enforce.en: The school will enforce the new rules next term.
enforce.zh: 学校将从下学期起执行新规定。

contend.en: Small shops must contend with rising costs.
contend.zh: 小商店必须应对不断上涨的成本。

array.en: The store offers an impressive array of teas.
array.zh: 这家商店提供种类繁多的茶。

obstacle.en: Lack of time was the main obstacle.

crystal.en: A tiny crystal formed in the solution.
crystal.zh: 溶液中形成了一颗微小的晶体。

arena.en: Thousands of fans filled the sports arena.
arena.zh: 数千名球迷坐满了体育馆。

drift.en: We watched the clouds drift across the sky.
drift.zh: 我们看着云朵从天空缓缓飘过。

maximum.en: The room can hold a maximum of forty people.
maximum.zh: 这个房间最多可容纳四十人。

outdoor.en: The hotel has an outdoor swimming pool.
outdoor.zh: 这家酒店有一个室外游泳池。

suck.zh: 婴儿经常吮吸自己的拇指。

random.en: The program selects a name at random.
random.zh: 程序随机选出一个名字。

leap.en: We watched the frog leap into the pond.
leap.zh: 我们看着青蛙跳进池塘。

domain.en: The results are now in the public domain.
domain.zh: 这些结果现在已经公开。

database.en: The library stores its records in a database.
database.zh: 图书馆将记录存储在数据库中。

limb.en: The tree lost a large limb in the storm.
limb.zh: 这棵树在暴风雨中折断了一根粗大的树枝。

horn.en: The driver sounded the horn before turning.
horn.zh: 司机在转弯前鸣了喇叭。

peaceful.en: We spent a peaceful afternoon by the lake.
peaceful.zh: 我们在湖边度过了一个宁静的下午。

pad.en: She wrote the address on a small pad.
pad.zh: 她把地址写在一个小便笺本上。

trigger.en: A small spark can trigger a fire.
trigger.zh: 一颗小火星就可能引发火灾。

virtual.en: We took a virtual tour of the museum.
virtual.zh: 我们以虚拟方式参观了这家博物馆。

convict.en: The jury decided to convict him of fraud.
convict.zh: 陪审团决定判定他犯有欺诈罪。

particle.en: A particle of dust floated in the sunlight.
particle.zh: 一粒灰尘在阳光中飘浮。

boost.en: A short break can boost your energy.
boost.zh: 短暂休息可以让你恢复精神。

outer.en: Remove the outer leaves before washing the cabbage.
outer.zh: 洗卷心菜前先去掉外层叶子。

freshman.en: He joined the club as a college freshman.
freshman.zh: 他在大学一年级时加入了这个社团。

ballot.zh: 每位成员都会收到一张选票。

web.en: A spider built a web across the window.
web.zh: 一只蜘蛛在窗前结了网。

chaos.en: The sudden power failure caused chaos.
chaos.zh: 突然停电造成了一片混乱。

format.en: Please save the file in PDF format.
format.zh: 请把文件保存为 PDF 格式。

canvas.en: The artist placed a blank canvas on the easel.
canvas.zh: 画家把一块空白画布放在画架上。

profound.en: The experience had a profound effect on her.
profound.zh: 这段经历对她产生了深远影响。

trait.en: Patience is a useful trait for a teacher.
trait.zh: 耐心是教师的一项重要品质。

currency.en: What currency is used in this country?
currency.zh: 这个国家使用什么货币？

beam.en: A beam of sunlight fell on the table.

bureau.en: The bureau publishes a report every month.
bureau.zh: 该局每个月发布一份报告。

scatter.en: Please do not scatter crumbs on the floor.
scatter.zh: 请不要把面包屑撒在地板上。

commonly.en: This word is commonly used in everyday speech.
commonly.zh: 这个词在日常口语中很常见。

disk.en: The files were saved on an external disk.
disk.zh: 文件保存在外置磁盘上。

suspend.en: The school decided to suspend classes for a day.

rebel.en: She began to rebel against the strict rules.
rebel.zh: 她开始反抗那些严格的规定。

spouse.en: You may bring your spouse to the dinner.
spouse.zh: 你可以带配偶参加晚宴。

output.en: The factory increased its output this year.

utility.en: The new road has great utility for local farmers.
utility.zh: 这条新路对当地农民很有用。

clinical.en: The treatment is still in clinical trials.
clinical.zh: 这种疗法仍处于临床试验阶段。

corporation.en: She works for a large international corporation.
corporation.zh: 她在一家大型跨国公司工作。

provision.en: The contract includes a provision for early payment.
provision.zh: 合同中包含一项提前付款的条款。

classic.en: This novel is a classic of English literature.
classic.zh: 这部小说是英国文学的经典作品。

mechanism.en: Nobody fully understands the mechanism behind this effect.
mechanism.zh: 还没有人完全了解这种现象背后的机制。

destruction.zh: 暴风雨造成了大范围的破坏。

infection.en: The test showed no sign of infection.
infection.zh: 检查没有发现感染迹象。

literary.en: She writes reviews for a literary magazine.
literary.zh: 她为一本文学杂志撰写评论。

strategic.en: The bridge has strategic importance for the region.
strategic.zh: 这座桥对该地区具有战略意义。

initially.en: I was initially unsure about the plan.
initially.zh: 起初我对这个计划没有把握。

expansion.en: The company announced the expansion of its network.

concentration.zh: 噪声让人难以集中注意力。

tournament.en: Our team reached the final of the tournament.
tournament.zh: 我们队进入了锦标赛决赛。

satisfaction.en: She smiled with satisfaction at the finished work.
satisfaction.zh: 看着完成的作品，她满意地笑了。

finance.en: He wants to study finance at university.

potentially.en: The change could potentially save a lot of time.
potentially.zh: 这一改变有可能节省大量时间。

politically.zh: 这个问题在政治上很敏感。

extensive.en: The museum has an extensive collection of maps.
extensive.zh: 博物馆收藏了大量地图。

characterize.en: How would you characterize her writing style?
characterize.zh: 你会如何描述她的写作风格？

violation.en: Parking here is a violation of the rules.

defensive.en: He became defensive when we questioned his decision.
defensive.zh: 当我们质疑他的决定时，他开始为自己辩解。

presentation.en: Her presentation explained the project clearly.
presentation.zh: 她的演示清楚地介绍了这个项目。

regardless.en: We will continue regardless of the weather.
regardless.zh: 无论天气如何，我们都会继续。

stable.en: Prices have remained stable this month.

introduction.en: The book begins with a short introduction.
introduction.zh: 这本书以一篇简短的导言开篇。

partnership.en: The project was completed in partnership with local schools.
partnership.zh: 这个项目是与当地学校合作完成的。

emission.en: The new buses reduce the emission of harmful gases.
emission.zh: 新公交车减少了有害气体的排放。

distinction.en: The course explains the distinction between fact and opinion.
distinction.zh: 这门课讲解事实与观点之间的区别。

variation.en: There is considerable variation in prices between shops.
variation.zh: 不同商店的价格差异很大。

radical.en: The plan requires a radical change in our approach.
radical.zh: 这个计划要求我们从根本上改变方法。

correspondent.en: The correspondent sent a report from the capital.
correspondent.zh: 记者从首都发来一篇报道。

evolution.en: The exhibition traces the evolution of the bicycle.
evolution.zh: 展览追溯了自行车的发展过程。

vulnerable.en: Young plants are vulnerable to frost.
vulnerable.zh: 幼苗容易受到霜冻的伤害。

capability.en: The camera has the capability to record video.
capability.zh: 这台相机具有录像功能。

stability.en: The new policy aims to improve economic stability.
stability.zh: 新政策旨在提高经济稳定性。

economist.en: The economist explained why prices were rising.
economist.zh: 这位经济学家解释了物价上涨的原因。

celebration.en: We held a small celebration after the exam.
celebration.zh: 考试结束后，我们举行了一次小型庆祝活动。

preference.en: Do you have a preference for tea or coffee?

incredible.en: The view from the top was incredible.

conviction.en: She spoke with conviction about the need for change.
conviction.zh: 她坚定地谈到改变的必要性。

maintenance.zh: 这台机器需要定期维护。

sophisticated.en: The new device uses sophisticated software.
sophisticated.zh: 这种新设备使用复杂精密的软件。

narrative.en: The film presents a simple narrative about friendship.
narrative.zh: 这部电影讲述了一个关于友谊的简单故事。

adjustment.en: The chair needs a slight adjustment.
adjustment.zh: 这把椅子需要稍微调整一下。

motivation.en: Her main motivation was to help others.
motivation.zh: 她的主要动机是帮助他人。

sequence.en: Put the pictures in the correct sequence.
sequence.zh: 把图片按正确顺序排列。

edition.en: I bought the latest edition of the textbook.
edition.zh: 我买了这本教材的最新版本。

manufacturing.en: The region has a strong manufacturing sector.

legitimate.en: Customers have a legitimate reason to complain.
legitimate.zh: 顾客有正当的理由投诉。

furthermore.en: The room is small; furthermore, it has no window.
furthermore.zh: 这个房间很小，而且没有窗户。

sanction.en: The government imposed an economic sanction.
sanction.zh: 政府实施了一项经济制裁。

nomination.en: Her nomination for the award surprised nobody.
nomination.zh: 她获得该奖项提名，大家都不意外。

tactic.en: Offering a free sample is a common sales tactic.
tactic.zh: 提供免费试用装是一种常见的销售策略。

invasion.en: The article describes the invasion of the island.
invasion.zh: 这篇文章描述了对该岛的入侵。

intensity.en: The intensity of the light can be adjusted.

confusion.zh: 相似的名字造成了混淆。

collective.en: The decision was the result of a collective effort.
collective.zh: 这项决定是大家共同努力的结果。

fitness.en: Walking regularly can improve your fitness.
fitness.zh: 经常步行可以增强体能。

surprisingly.zh: 这次考试出乎意料地简单。

indication.en: There was no indication that the train would be late.
indication.zh: 没有迹象表明火车会晚点。

alliance.en: The two groups formed an alliance.
alliance.zh: 这两个团体结成了联盟。

regulate.en: The device helps regulate the temperature.
regulate.zh: 这个装置有助于调节温度。

adolescent.en: The book describes the life of an adolescent.
adolescent.zh: 这本书描述了一名青少年的生活。

magic.en: The children enjoyed the magic show.
magic.zh: 孩子们很喜欢这场魔术表演。

essence.en: In essence, the two proposals are very similar.
essence.zh: 本质上，这两个提议非常相似。

initiate.en: We will initiate a review of the process.
initiate.zh: 我们将开始审查这一流程。

mainstream.en: The idea is now part of mainstream thinking.
mainstream.zh: 这个想法如今已成为主流观念的一部分。

motivate.en: A clear goal can motivate people to work harder.
motivate.zh: 明确的目标能激励人们更加努力。

seemingly.en: The seemingly simple task took hours.
seemingly.zh: 这个看似简单的任务花了好几个小时。

companion.en: My dog is a loyal companion.
companion.zh: 我的狗是一个忠诚的伙伴。

inspector.en: The inspector checked the fire exits.
inspector.zh: 检查员检查了消防出口。

overwhelming.en: The proposal was approved by an overwhelming majority.
overwhelming.zh: 这项提案以压倒性多数获得通过。

diagnosis.en: The doctor explained the diagnosis to the patient.
diagnosis.zh: 医生向病人解释了诊断结果。

consistently.en: She consistently arrives before everyone else.

questionnaire.zh: 请填写这份简短的问卷。

hence.en: The road is closed, hence the delay.
hence.zh: 道路封闭了，因此出现了延误。

chronic.en: The town has a chronic shortage of housing.

administer.en: The office will administer the new program.
administer.zh: 这个办公室将负责管理新项目。

respectively.en: The tickets cost ten and fifteen dollars, respectively.
respectively.zh: 这两种票的价格分别为十美元和十五美元。

astronomer.en: The astronomer observed a distant star.
astronomer.zh: 这位天文学家观测了一颗遥远的恒星。

pickup.en: Your order will be ready for pickup at noon.
pickup.zh: 你的订单中午就可以取货。

timing.en: Good timing is essential in this game.
timing.zh: 在这个游戏中，把握好时机非常重要。

portfolio.en: The designer showed us her portfolio.
portfolio.zh: 这位设计师向我们展示了她的作品集。

shuttle.en: A free shuttle runs between the airport and the hotel.
shuttle.zh: 机场与酒店之间有免费接驳车。

rider.en: The rider got off the horse at the gate.

residential.en: The shop is in a quiet residential area.
residential.zh: 这家商店位于一个安静的住宅区。

diagnose.en: Further tests are needed to diagnose the problem.
diagnose.zh: 还需要进一步检测才能诊断这个问题。

liberty.zh: 这项法律保护个人自由。

pit.en: Workers dug a deep pit beside the road.
pit.zh: 工人在路旁挖了一个深坑。

wildlife.zh: 这个保护区保护当地的野生动植物。

teenage.en: She wrote the story during her teenage years.
teenage.zh: 她在青少年时期写下了这个故事。

pursuit.en: He traveled widely in pursuit of knowledge.

oral.en: The course includes an oral examination.

reporting.zh: 这个奖项表彰优秀的新闻报道。

endorse.en: Several teachers agreed to endorse the proposal.
endorse.zh: 几位老师同意支持这个提议。

feedback.en: Thank you for your helpful feedback.
feedback.zh: 感谢你提供的有益反馈。

thereby.en: The new route is shorter, thereby saving time.
thereby.zh: 新路线更短，因此节省了时间。

indicator.en: Sales figures are one indicator of demand.
indicator.zh: 销售数据是反映需求的一项指标。

spectrum.en: The course covers a broad spectrum of topics.
spectrum.zh: 这门课涉及广泛的主题。

sunlight.en: The plant needs plenty of sunlight.
sunlight.zh: 这种植物需要充足的阳光。

bold.en: She made a bold decision to start her own business.

realm.en: The question belongs in the realm of philosophy.
realm.zh: 这个问题属于哲学领域。

accounting.en: She took a course in accounting.
accounting.zh: 她修读了一门会计课程。

huh.en: Huh, I thought the shop was open today.
huh.zh: 嗯，我还以为这家店今天营业呢。

metaphor.en: The poet uses the sea as a metaphor for life.

chin.en: He rested his chin on his hand.

starter.en: We ordered soup as a starter.
starter.zh: 我们点了汤作为开胃菜。

banking.en: She uses an app for her everyday banking.
banking.zh: 她用一款应用处理日常银行业务。

utility.zh: 水电燃气等公用事业账单

corporation.meaningZh: n. 公司；法人；法人团体
corporation.reason: 删除误译“合作”，公司与corporation法人义。

presentation.meaningZh: n. 演示；报告；展示；介绍；呈现；赠送

virtual.meaningZh: adj. 虚拟的；事实上的；实际上的

fitness.meaningZh: n. 健康；体能；适合；适当

portfolio.meaningZh: n. 作品集；投资组合；公文包；部长职务
portfolio.reason: 补足作品集/投资组合常用义。

pad.meaningZh: n. 垫子；衬垫；便笺本；肉垫；v. 加衬垫；填塞；虚增
pad.reason: 补充便笺本常用义，删除无语境的误导孤立义“路”。

pickup.meaningZh: n. 取货；接人；皮卡车；拾起；好转；拾音器
pickup.reason: 补足生活常用取货、接人、皮卡义。

starter.meaningZh: n. 开胃菜；启动装置；起跑者；首发队员；起始物
starter.reason: 补足餐饮、机器、运动常用义。

render.meaningZh: v. 使成为；给予；提供；表现；翻译；渲染
render.reason: 修复“给于”错字，常用使成为/提供/渲染义优先。

regardless.meaningZh: adv. 不顾；不管；不加理会地
regardless.reason: 原词性a.错误；regardless of是介词短语，不使单词成为形容词。

consistently.meaningZh: adv. 始终如一地；一贯地；持续地
consistently.reason: 删除不能代表该副词常用义的“坚固，坚实”。

overwhelming.meaningZh: adj. 压倒性的；巨大的；难以抵挡的
overwhelming.reason: 补充证据、支持、情绪等语境的巨大的/压倒性义。

strategic.meaningZh: adj. 战略的；策略上的；至关重要的
strategic.reason: 补充日常策略及重要位置义。

finance.meaningZh: n. 金融；财政；财务；资金；v. 为…提供资金；筹措资金
finance.reason: 补充金融及资金常用义。

generally.meaningZh: adv. 通常；一般地；普遍地；大体上
generally.reason: “逐渐地”对应 gradually，与 generally 的通常/总体义不同。

fundamentally.meaningZh: adv. 根本上；从根本上说；基本上；本质上
fundamentally.reason: 基频/基音/基谐波是 fundamental 的名词义，不能附在副词 fundamentally 上。

sales.meaningZh:
n. 销售；销售量；销售额；销售业务
adj. 销售的
sales.reason: 原词仅标 adj. 销售的，无法解释本条自带例句 Sales fell off in the third quarter. 的名词主语。

jobless.meaningZh: adj. 失业的；没有工作的
jobless.reason: jobless 是没有工作，失职是未履行职责，两者不同。

importantly.meaningZh: adv. 重要地；更重要的是（常见于 more importantly）；自命不凡地
importantly.reason: “大量地”“有名望地”不是 importantly 的适当常用义；more importantly 的提示语义缺失。

nervousness.meaningZh: n. 紧张不安；神经过敏；易激动
nervousness.reason: “神经”“神经元”分别对应 nerve/neuron，不能将器官/细胞名解释为 nervousness 这一状态名词。

genetically.meaningZh: adv. 在遗传上；从基因角度；以基因方式
genetically.reason: 现释义含“遗传学/生殖/基因”等裸名词，是词性不匹配；应表达基因/遗传方面的副词义。

visually.meaningZh: adv. 在视觉上；凭视觉；在外观上
visually.reason: 现释义把 visual 的“视力/视觉/光学”等名词形容词义混入 visually；应表达视觉方式或外观方面。

infection.meaningZh: n. 感染；传染；传染病；（情绪等的）感染
infection.reason: 核心医学感染义缺失，“影响”过泛，无法准确解释本词自带 an infection / cross infection。

emission.meaningZh: n. 排放；排放物；发射；散发
emission.reason: 补足日常环保语境核心排放义；现有“发行”不是本学习条目排放/发射语境的适当常用释义。

initiate.meaningZh:
n. 新入会者；初学者；入门者
adj. 新入会的；初步的
v. 发起；开始；使初步了解；接纳入会
initiate.reason: 现名词“入会、开始”把动作当人，无法解释本条自带 the initiate 及 novice/beginner 近义项。

collectively.meaningZh: adv. 集体地；共同地；总共
collectively.reason: 现释义“集体主义/集团”等名词是 collective 的其他词性义，不是副词 collectively 的意义。

decidedly.meaningZh: adv. 确实；显然；果断地；坚决地
